title: Fixture home
meta_description: A home page for the fault fixture site, long enough not to be flagged as short by the meta description check.

title: About
meta_description: About page for the fixture site, written long enough to avoid the short description finding.

title: Insecure form
meta_description: A form posting to a plain http URL on another host, which is the insecure form fault under test.

title: A clean second page
meta_description: A second clean page, present so the clean case is asserted and not merely assumed by the fixture.

title: Local and staging links
meta_description: Links to localhost, a private address and a staging subdomain, plus one real site that must stay quiet.

title: Placeholder copy
meta_description: Page carrying lorem ipsum placeholder text in its opening paragraph, which is the fault under test here.

title: Canonical to a redirect
meta_description: The canonical names a URL that redirects elsewhere, so Google has to follow a hop to reach the real page.

title: Canonical to a noindex page
meta_description: The canonical names a page set to noindex, so neither URL ends up in the index at all.

title: Images with no dimensions
meta_description: Two images with no width or height attributes and one sized correctly, for the layout shift check.

title: Noindex hub
meta_description: A noindex archive page which is the only inbound link to another page, for the link equity check.

title: Blog
meta_description: A blog index declaring rel next while nothing on the page links to page two with an anchor tag.

title: Search results
meta_description: An internal search results page, which is thin, infinite in number, and has no business being indexed.

title: English page
meta_description: English page naming a French alternate which never names it back, so the cluster is one way.

title: Page francaise
meta_description: French page that declares only itself, which is what breaks the return link the English page expects.

title: Dead end
meta_description: A page with no internal outlinks at all, so crawling and link equity both stop when they arrive here.

title: Services
meta_description: Services page for the fixture site, written long enough to avoid the short description finding.

title: A very large document
meta_description: An HTML document deliberately larger than two megabytes, past the point Google stops reading one.

title: Redirect target
meta_description: The destination of the fixture redirect, linked from nowhere so the redirecting row survives the crawl.

title: Canonical with a fragment
meta_description: The canonical on this page carries a fragment, which resolves to a different URL than the one written.

title: Canonical to a 404
meta_description: The canonical names a URL that returns 404, so this page hands indexing to somewhere that cannot be indexed.

title: Inert markup
meta_description: Sitewide theme chrome that a raw read mistakes for faults: icon titles, a menu template and a quick-view dialog.

title: Links to redirects
meta_description: A page whose links point at URLs that redirect to pages the crawl reaches through the navigation anyway.
